name: Layout command bar and broadcast
summary: A bar across the top of an open Layout that searches every terminal in it at once, or sends one command to every terminal whose broadcast toggle is on.
description: The bar shows the Layout's name and one box with one mode toggle inside it: a magnifying glass in search mode, a ">" in command mode. Search mode (the default) runs the query in every member terminal through that terminal's own search, with the same "in prompt only" switch, a count per terminal and in total, and next and previous across terminals. Command mode sends the typed line plus Enter to every live member whose ">" toggle is on, after showing how many will receive it ("to 2 of 3", a chip that also opens a menu to choose which terminals); a member that is working right now asks first, and a pane stopped on a dialog is refused rather than answered. Each member terminal carries the ">" toggle in its title bar, on by default and stored with the Layout so every device agrees - the bar's recipients menu sets the same value, and a clean send says nothing further (Enter is already the confirmation); a skip or a failure still reports in the result line. While the desktop drawer is collapsed to its mini rail, the box right-justifies to the header's right edge. In command mode a line that starts with "/" or "$" opens a skill list under the box: every global skill plus the project skills that every terminal the line would reach has, filtered as you type, each with its one-line description and scope.
where: Open a saved Layout (a LAYOUTS row in the agents drawer): the bar sits in the tab row above its terminals, to the right of the Layout's name tab.
Each terminal in the Layout carries a ">" toggle in its title bar, beside its tools - the one recipients control, on every width including a phone.
how_to: Type in the box: search mode (the magnifying glass, the default) finds the text in every terminal at once; each terminal shows its own count and the bar shows the total.
Press Enter or Shift+Enter to walk the matches from one terminal into the next; the prompt icon limits the search to prompts you sent, the same switch as a single terminal's search.
Click the mode toggle to switch to command mode: its icon swaps from the magnifying glass to ">".
Escape clears the box, and a second Escape leaves it.

In command mode, start the line with "/" (Claude Code) or "$" (Codex) to list skills: every global skill plus the project skills each receiving terminal shares. Keep typing to filter, Up and Down to move, Tab or Enter to insert, Escape to close, or click a row.
examples: Three agents on one repo: search "error" to see which of them hit a failure, then send "git status" to all three at once.
Leave a long-running session's ">" off so a broadcast "npm test" only reaches the other terminals.
media_exempt: screenshots and captures are not part of the open source export
